"""Closed-loop load generator for the B300 aux services.

One process per shard; total concurrency = level. Each thread keeps one HTTP
connection and loops request -> response until the window ends. Warm-up requests
finish before the measured window starts, so no warm-up latency leaks into it.

Reports req/s, p50/p95/p99, error rate and RTF (processing time / audio time,
so < 1 is faster than real time), plus the raw latencies for exact merging.

Usage:
  python bench_aux.py --svc stt --level 200 --duration 60 --warmup 10 --shard 0 --shards 4
"""
import argparse
import io
import json
import math
import os
import random
import threading
import time
import wave

import requests

HOSTS = {
    "emb": ("qwen3-embedding-8b.embed-rerank.svc.cluster.local", 8000, "/v1/embeddings"),
    "rr": ("jina-reranker-v35.embed-rerank.svc.cluster.local", 8000, "/v1/rerank"),
    "tts": ("tts-vllm.speech.svc.cluster.local", 8000, "/v1/completions"),
    "ttsapi": ("tts-api.speech.svc.cluster.local", 8000, "/v1/audio/speech"),
    "stt": ("stt-vllm.speech.svc.cluster.local", 8000, "/v1/audio/transcriptions"),
    "sttapi": ("stt-api.speech.svc.cluster.local", 8000, "/audio/transcriptions"),
}

EMB_TEXT = ("Saya ingin bertanya mengenai bil bulan ini. Bil menunjukkan jumlah yang lebih tinggi "
            "daripada bulan sebelumnya, dan saya tidak pasti apakah ini kerana penggunaan data yang "
            "berlebihan atau kerana caj tambahan. Boleh anda terangkan pecahan caj tersebut?") * 3
RR_QUERY = "How do I restore my Unifi service after a late payment?"
RR_DOCS = [
    "Restoration is available once the outstanding balance is settled in full. A payment made today is reflected within one hour.",
    "If the account is barred for non-payment, the service resumes automatically after the payment posts to the billing system.",
    "A partial payment leaves the account barred until the remaining balance is cleared or a payment arrangement is approved.",
    "Customers on autopay should check that the card on file has not expired; a failed charge bars the line after seven days.",
    "A reconnection fee may apply when the line has been barred for more than thirty days; the fee is shown before payment.",
    "To check the balance, open the Unifi app, select Billing, and read the outstanding amount on the account summary.",
    "A payment arrangement splits the outstanding balance across three months and keeps the service active while it is honoured.",
    "If the service is still barred six hours after payment, contact Care Crew with the payment reference for a manual restore.",
]
TTS_TEXTS = [
    "Baik, saya sudah semak akaun tuan. Bil bulan ini berjumlah dua ratus tiga puluh lima ringgit dan tujuh puluh sen. Ia merangkumi caj bulanan dan penggunaan data tambahan sebanyak dua puluh ringgit. Adakah tuan ingin membuat pembayaran sekarang?",
    "Terima kasih kerana menghubungi Unifi. Saya dapati talian tuan mengalami gangguan sejak pagi tadi. Pasukan teknikal sedang memeriksa kawasan tersebut dan anggaran pemulihan adalah dalam masa empat jam. Saya akan maklumkan kepada tuan jika ada perkembangan.",
    "Untuk memulihkan perkhidmatan, tuan perlu menjelaskan baki tertunggak terlebih dahulu. Selepas pembayaran diterima, talian akan diaktifkan semula dalam masa satu jam. Sila pastikan nombor akaun disebut dengan betul semasa pembayaran dibuat.",
    "Saya boleh membantu tuan menukar pelan kepada pakej yang lebih sesuai. Pakej baharu akan berkuat kuasa pada hari pertama bulan hadapan, dan tiada caj penalti dikenakan untuk pertukaran ini. Adakah tuan ingin saya teruskan?",
]


def make_wav(seconds: float) -> bytes:
    n = int(16000 * seconds)
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    with wave.open(buf, "wb") as w:
        w.setnchannels(1)
        w.setsampwidth(2)
        w.setframerate(16000)
        w.writeframes(os.urandom(2 * n))
    return buf.getvalue()


def payload(svc: str, i: int):
    if svc == "emb":
        return {"json": {"model": "Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-8B", "input": EMB_TEXT}}
    if svc == "rr":
        return {"json": {"model": "jina-reranker-v3.5", "query": RR_QUERY, "documents": RR_DOCS}}
    if svc == "tts":
        text = TTS_TEXTS[i % len(TTS_TEXTS)]
        prompt = f"<|im_start|>user\n{text}<|im_end|>\n<|im_start|>assistant\n"
        return {"json": {"model": "TTS-model", "prompt": prompt, "max_tokens": 512,
                         "temperature": 0.0}}
    if svc == "ttsapi":
        return {"json": {"model": "TTS-model", "voice": "haiqal",
                         "input": TTS_TEXTS[i % len(TTS_TEXTS)], "response_format": "wav"}}
    if svc == "stt":
        dur = math.exp(random.uniform(math.log(1.0), math.log(10.0)))
        wav = make_wav(dur)
        return {"files": {"file": ("a.wav", wav, "audio/wav")},
                "data": {"model": "scicom-ai-enterprise/whisper-large-v3-turbo-2025-09-09"},
                "_audio_s": dur}
    if svc == "sttapi":
        dur = math.exp(random.uniform(math.log(1.0), math.log(10.0)))
        wav = make_wav(dur)
        return {"files": {"file": ("a.wav", wav, "audio/wav")}, "data": {"language": "en"},
                "_audio_s": dur}
    raise SystemExit("unknown svc " + svc)


def wav_seconds(body: bytes) -> float:
    """Duration from the RIFF chunks, tolerating a streaming 0xFFFFFFFF data size."""
    if len(body) < 44 or body[:4] != b"RIFF":
        return len(body) / 2.0 / 24000.0
    i, rate, ch, bits, data_off, data_len = 12, 24000, 1, 16, None, None
    while i + 8 <= len(body):
        cid, sz = body[i:i + 4], int.from_bytes(body[i + 4:i + 8], "little")
        if cid == b"fmt ":
            ch = int.from_bytes(body[i + 10:i + 12], "little")
            rate = int.from_bytes(body[i + 12:i + 16], "little")
            bits = int.from_bytes(body[i + 22:i + 24], "little")
        elif cid == b"data":
            data_off, data_len = i + 8, sz
            break
        i += 8 + sz + (sz & 1)
    if data_off is None:
        return len(body) / 2.0 / 24000.0
    n = len(body) - data_off if data_len in (0, 0xFFFFFFFF) else min(data_len, len(body) - data_off)
    return n / float(rate * ch * max(1, bits // 8))


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--svc", required=True, choices=list(HOSTS))
    ap.add_argument("--level", type=int, required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--duration", type=int, default=60)
    ap.add_argument("--warmup", type=int, default=10)
    ap.add_argument("--shard", type=int, default=0)
    ap.add_argument("--shards", type=int, default=1)
    args = ap.parse_args()

    host, port, path = HOSTS[args.svc]
    conc = max(1, math.ceil(args.level / args.shards))
    base = f"http://{host}:{port}"
    stop = threading.Event()
    warm_done = threading.Event()
    barrier_start = threading.Barrier(conc + 1)
    barrier_window = threading.Barrier(conc + 1)
    lock = threading.Lock()
    stats = {"lat": [], "err": 0, "n": 0, "audio": 0.0, "errs": []}

    def one(s, i, record):
        p = payload(args.svc, i)
        audio_s = p.pop("_audio_s", 0.0)
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        body = b""
        try:
            r = s.post(base + path, timeout=120, **p)
            body = r.content
            ok = 200 <= r.status_code < 300
        except Exception as e:
            ok = False
            with lock:
                if len(stats["errs"]) < 3:
                    stats["errs"].append(type(e).__name__ + ": " + str(e)[:120])
        dt = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000.0
        if record:
            with lock:
                stats["n"] += 1
                stats["lat"].append(dt)
                if ok:
                    if args.svc == "ttsapi":
                        stats["audio"] += wav_seconds(body)
                    elif args.svc == "tts":
                        try:
                            txt = r.json()["choices"][0]["text"]
                            stats["audio"] += txt.count("<|s_") / 50.0
                        except Exception:
                            pass
                    elif args.svc in ("stt", "sttapi"):
                        stats["audio"] += audio_s
                else:
                    stats["err"] += 1
        return i + 1

    def worker(tid: int):
        s = requests.Session()
        s.mount("http://", requests.adapters.HTTPAdapter(pool_connections=4, pool_maxsize=4))
        i = tid
        barrier_start.wait()
        while not warm_done.is_set():
            i = one(s, i, False)
        barrier_window.wait()
        while not stop.is_set():
            i = one(s, i, True)

    threads = [threading.Thread(target=worker, args=(t,), daemon=True) for t in range(conc)]
    for t in threads:
        t.start()
    barrier_start.wait()
    time.sleep(args.warmup)
    warm_done.set()
    barrier_window.wait()
    with lock:
        stats["lat"].clear(); stats["n"] = 0; stats["err"] = 0; stats["audio"] = 0.0
    t_start = time.perf_counter()
    time.sleep(args.duration)
    stop.set()
    for t in threads:
        t.join(timeout=30)
    elapsed = time.perf_counter() - t_start

    lat = sorted(stats["lat"])
    def pct(p):
        return lat[min(len(lat) - 1, int(len(lat) * p))] if lat else None
    wall = sum(x / 1000.0 for x in lat)
    out = {
        "svc": args.svc, "level": args.level, "shard": args.shard, "shards": args.shards,
        "conc": conc, "elapsed_s": round(elapsed, 1), "n": stats["n"],
        "rps": round(stats["n"] / elapsed, 2),
        "err": stats["err"], "err_pct": round(100.0 * stats["err"] / max(1, stats["n"]), 2),
        "p50_ms": round(pct(0.50), 1) if lat else None,
        "p95_ms": round(pct(0.95), 1) if lat else None,
        "p99_ms": round(pct(0.99), 1) if lat else None,
        "max_ms": round(lat[-1], 1) if lat else None,
        "rtf": round(wall / stats["audio"], 4) if stats["audio"] else None,
        "x_realtime": round(stats["audio"] / max(1e-9, wall), 1) if stats["audio"] else None,
        "audio_s": round(stats["audio"], 1),
        "audio_per_req_s": round(stats["audio"] / max(1, stats["n"]), 2) if stats["audio"] else None,
        "errors": stats["errs"],
        "lat": [round(x, 1) for x in lat],
    }
    print(json.dumps(out))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Enhancer WebSocket load generator: one socket per call, 50 ms chunks at 20/s."""
import argparse, asyncio, json, math, os, time
import aiohttp

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--url", default="ws://enhancer.speech.svc.cluster.local:8765")
    ap.add_argument("--streams", type=int, required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--duration", type=int, default=60)
    ap.add_argument("--warmup", type=int, default=20)
    ap.add_argument("--shard", type=int, default=0)
    ap.add_argument("--shards", type=int, default=1)
    ap.add_argument("--chunk-ms", type=int, default=40)
    a = ap.parse_args()
    conc = max(1, math.ceil(a.streams / a.shards))
    chunk = os.urandom(2 * 16 * a.chunk_ms)  # 16 kHz int16
    stop = asyncio.Event(); warm = asyncio.Event()
    lat = []; errs = []; audio = 0.0; sent = 0; err = 0
    lock = asyncio.Lock()

    async def stream(idx):
        nonlocal audio, sent, err
        try:
            async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as s:
                async with s.ws_connect(a.url, max_msg_size=0, timeout=aiohttp.ClientWSTimeout(ws_close=5)) as ws:
                    while not stop.is_set():
                        t0 = time.perf_counter()
                        await ws.send_bytes(chunk)
                        msg = await asyncio.wait_for(ws.receive(), timeout=10)
                        dt = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000.0
                        if msg.type == aiohttp.WSMsgType.BINARY:
                            if warm.is_set():
                                n = len(msg.data) if msg.data else 0
                                async with lock:
                                    lat.append(dt); audio += (n / 2.0) / 16000.0; sent += 1
                        elif msg.type in (aiohttp.WSMsgType.CLOSE, aiohttp.WSMsgType.ERROR):
                            raise RuntimeError("closed")
                        await asyncio.sleep(max(0.0, a.chunk_ms / 1000.0 - (time.perf_counter() - t0)))
        except Exception as e:
            async with lock:
                err += 1
                if len(errs) < 3: errs.append(type(e).__name__ + ": " + str(e)[:120])

    async def run():
        nonlocal err, audio, sent
        tasks = [asyncio.create_task(stream(i)) for i in range(conc)]
        await asyncio.sleep(a.warmup); warm.set()
        async with lock: lat.clear(); audio = 0.0; sent = 0
        t0 = time.perf_counter(); await asyncio.sleep(a.duration); stop.set()
        await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
        el = time.perf_counter() - t0
        lat.sort()
        def pct(p): return lat[min(len(lat)-1, int(len(lat)*p))] if lat else None
        wall = sum(lat) / 1000.0
        print(json.dumps({"svc":"enh","streams":a.streams,"shard":a.shard,"conc":conc,"elapsed_s":round(el,1),
            "chunks":sent,"chunks_s":round(sent/el,1),"err":err,"err_pct":round(100*err/max(1,conc),2),
            "p50_ms":round(pct(0.5),1) if lat else None,"p95_ms":round(pct(0.95),1) if lat else None,
            "p99_ms":round(pct(0.99),1) if lat else None,
            "over_30_pct":round(100*sum(1 for x in lat if x>30)/max(1,len(lat)),2),
            "over_200_pct":round(100*sum(1 for x in lat if x>200)/max(1,len(lat)),2),
            "rtf":round(wall/audio,4) if audio else None,"audio_s":round(audio,1),"errors":errs,
            "lat":[round(x,1) for x in lat]}))
    asyncio.run(run())

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
data.bench_eot.py:
"""EOT /predict load generator: base64 s16le 16 kHz PCM, closed-loop."""
import argparse, base64, io, json, math, os, random, threading, time, wave
import requests

def wav(seconds):
    n = int(16000 * seconds)
    return os.urandom(2 * n)

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--url", default="http://eot.speech.svc.cluster.local:9097/predict")
    ap.add_argument("--level", type=int, required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--duration", type=int, default=60)
    ap.add_argument("--warmup", type=int, default=10)
    ap.add_argument("--shard", type=int, default=0)
    ap.add_argument("--shards", type=int, default=1)
    ap.add_argument("--min-s", type=float, default=1.0)
    ap.add_argument("--max-s", type=float, default=3.0)
    a = ap.parse_args()
    conc = max(1, math.ceil(a.level / a.shards))
    stop = threading.Event(); warm = threading.Event()
    b0 = threading.Barrier(conc + 1); b1 = threading.Barrier(conc + 1)
    lock = threading.Lock(); st = {"lat": [], "n": 0, "err": 0, "audio": 0.0, "errs": []}

    def one(s, record):
        dur = math.exp(random.uniform(math.log(a.min_s), math.log(a.max_s)))
        pcm = wav(dur)
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        try:
            r = s.post(a.url, json={"audio": base64.b64encode(pcm).decode(), "sample_rate": 16000}, timeout=120)
            ok = 200 <= r.status_code < 300
        except Exception as e:
            ok = False
            with lock:
                if len(st["errs"]) < 3: st["errs"].append(type(e).__name__ + ": " + str(e)[:120])
        dt = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000.0
        if record:
            with lock:
                st["n"] += 1; st["lat"].append(dt)
                if ok: st["audio"] += dur
                else: st["err"] += 1

    def worker(tid):
        s = requests.Session(); s.mount("http://", requests.adapters.HTTPAdapter(pool_connections=4, pool_maxsize=4))
        b0.wait()
        while not warm.is_set(): one(s, False)
        b1.wait()
        while not stop.is_set(): one(s, True)

    ts = [threading.Thread(target=worker, args=(i,), daemon=True) for i in range(conc)]
    for t in ts: t.start()
    b0.wait(); time.sleep(a.warmup); warm.set(); b1.wait()
    with lock: st["lat"].clear(); st["n"] = 0; st["err"] = 0; st["audio"] = 0.0
    t0 = time.perf_counter(); time.sleep(a.duration); stop.set()
    for t in ts: t.join(timeout=30)
    el = time.perf_counter() - t0
    lat = sorted(st["lat"])
    def pct(p): return lat[min(len(lat)-1, int(len(lat)*p))] if lat else None
    wall = sum(lat) / 1000.0
    print(json.dumps({"svc":"eot","level":a.level,"shard":a.shard,"conc":conc,"elapsed_s":round(el,1),
        "n":st["n"],"rps":round(st["n"]/el,2),"err":st["err"],"err_pct":round(100*st["err"]/max(1,st["n"]),2),
        "p50_ms":round(pct(0.5),1) if lat else None,"p95_ms":round(pct(0.95),1) if lat else None,
        "p99_ms":round(pct(0.99),1) if lat else None,"max_ms":round(lat[-1],1) if lat else None,
        "rtf":round(wall/st["audio"],4) if st["audio"] else None,"audio_s":round(st["audio"],1),
        "errors":st["errs"],"lat":[round(x,1) for x in lat]}))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
